features.description: Voice confirmation for risky actions in the menu-bar voice flow
steps: When a voice command is classified as external/destructive, menu app asks for confirmation instead of blocking on CLI input
Hold the pending command during the same recording cycle while capturing confirmation audio

features.evidence: Voice confirmation flow in _record_and_execute: after STT, if classify_risk returns EXTERNAL_OR_DESTRUCTIVE, TTS asks user to confirm, then records confirmation audio, transcribes it, and checks is_voice_confirm(). Agree keywords (同意/确认/继续 etc.) proceed; reject (取消/不要/拒绝 etc.) aborts; unclear input aborts for safety. Accepted voice confirmation calls _run_pipeline(..., confirmation_override=True) so the background menu app does not block on CLI input. Low-risk passes confirmation_override=None. is_voice_confirm uses bilingual keyword sets with exact matching for single-character Chinese keywords to avoid false positives like '不错'. 9 F064 tests: agree, reject, unclear, single-character matching, high-risk accepted flow, low-risk skip, spoken rejection skip, unclear skip, and pipeline confirmation override. 223/223 tests, lint clean.
